text: Asking the Lord's forgiveness for any slips made knowingly or unknowingly, offer akshatas and recite this verse.
The murti need not be moved — the Lord stays home for three, five or nine days before the immersion farewell.
Till then, light the lamp and offer arati every morning and evening.
Your puja is complete — may his blessings fill your home!
న్యూనం సమ్పూర్ణతాం యాతి సద్యో వన్దే గణాధిపమ్ ॥
